timeline_and_information_availability.availability_verdict: 120 periods are NOT available before monitoring begins (t=24). They ARE available before fault injection and attribution decisions (t=120).

leakage_audit.leakage_verdict: PASSED. W=120 uses only observed demand in t in [0, 119], with zero access to ground-truth cells or post-injection data.

candidate_c6_recall_impact.nature_of_unlatched_detections: All 10 unlatched detections at t=120 were false alarms caused by W=24 initialization error before the injection took effect. Genuine injection destination is reached post-t=144.

confounding_audit.c4_confounding_details: In Monitor.read(), y_base for C4 dispersion ratio is y[:max(b, w4)], where b=min(W_base, n). Setting global W_base=120 alters C4's baseline from 24 to 120 periods.
confounding_audit.c5_confounding_details: In Monitor.read(), base_sz for C5 CUSUM scale sigma_base uses base_slice=slice(0, b). Setting global W_base=120 alters CUSUM calibration from 24 to 120 periods.
confounding_audit.c6_isolation_requirement: Any implementation of W=120 must be isolated to C6 (e.g. W_c6_base), and must NOT globally alter W_base.

limitations_of_saved_data.saved_trajectories_status: Existing parquet files record boolean firings under W=24. They do not record rolling cell strings for all checkpoints or full 7-cause rule firings post-t=144.
limitations_of_saved_data.requirement_for_full_evaluation: A full pipeline replay on training data is required to measure post-144 C6 recall and ensure no new preemption or false positives emerge.

final_audit_decision.decision: B. More training-only evidence is needed.
final_audit_decision.justification: W=120 is mechanistically sound and eliminates 9 of 14 C0 false positives, but: (1) 120 periods are not available at monitoring start (t=24); (2) changing global W_base confounds C4 and C5; (3) post-144 recall under the isolated 7-cause pipeline must be verified on training data before any validation trial.
